notes: full_acceptance is always false in this lane
a JSON field named passed is not acceptance
process RSS/CPU/FD/thread samples are not hardware acceptance
the vm lane owns tests/vm; this lane starts no VM
ceilings: max 2 VMs, 2 vCPU, 1 GiB, and max 1 Xvfb here
a private XDG_RUNTIME_DIR alone is not isolation
build slots use flock --close or a CLOEXEC lock held by the parent until the contained tree is verified dead
lock opens use O_NOFOLLOW and require a private regular file with nlink 1 before flock or write
job and build commands run in a probed pid namespace; a marker scan is not complete cleanup
SIGKILL and exit 137 are an unknown cause unless coordinator provenance is present
private Xvfb uses an explicit display >= 700 and proves the filesystem socket and the abstract socket before input
both listening X socket inodes must be fds of the spawned server before input
bare -displayfd is unused; foreign X sockets and locks are not unlinked

an unverified drain does not release the build slot; a missing, truncated, or malformed drain is unverified, and an unknown namespace-init start keeps the lock; each contained track is pre-registered pending before spawn on an invocation-unique drain path and must be proven on its own; namespace_empty true from an earlier run is not that proof

coordinator SIGKILL cascades through parent-death while a guardian holds the lock until every contained track has its own invocation-bound verified drain or its own complete known-start init death; a completed build init does not cover a later command
full_acceptance stays false when another JSON file says passed
